digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier epic-close bug screen and gate
propositions: The epic-close bug screen degrades systematic LLM provider errors (e.g., Bedrock ValidationException on max_tokens overflow) to per-candidate 'unrelated' verdicts instead of propagating them, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when the provider is misconfigured or degraded.

LLMUnavailableError raised from epic_bug_screen.screen_candidates (warm call or fan-out worker) is caught by a broad per-candidate exception handler and converted to verdict C, preventing the provider error from surfacing to the close gate's fail-closed handler.

LLMUnavailableError raised from epic_bug_screen.run_screen is caught by an advisory-shield broad except, allowing the screen's provider failure to degrade silently instead of blocking the close as intended.

The completion verifier must fail-closed on any LLMUnavailableError (including subclass LLMConfigError) to match the absent-provider fail-closed path, with --force-close as the documented escape hatch.
Non-systemic per-candidate failures (malformed output, store read errors, exceptions other than LLMUnavailableError) must continue to degrade-open to verdict C per the documented behavior.
